title: Production Manager (Fabrication), Vadodara, GUJ
description:
Trelleborg is a world leader in engineered polymer solutions for almost every industry on the planet. And we are where we are because our talents brought us here. By specializing in the polymer engineering that makes innovation and application possible, Trelleborg works closely with leading industry brands to accelerate their performance, drive their business forward—and along the way, shape the industry and progress that will benefit humankind in the exciting years ahead. Our people are Shaping Industry from the Inside. Why don´t you join us?

Make your mark on the future. Accelerate your career with Trelleborg and start shaping industry from the inside.

**Who are we?**

Trelleborg Industrial Solutions (TIS) is a global leader in innovative polymer-based solutions for key industries and critical infrastructure. We are one of three Business Areas within the Trelleborg Group, with a total of about 6 200 employees around the world.

Trelleborg Marine & Infrastructure are committed to advancing operational performance in marine, port and built infrastructure, empowering our clients to succeed at the highest level.

**Job Summary**

The Production Manager will oversee fabrication operations, ensuring production targets, quality standards, safety compliance, and project timelines are consistently achieved. The role is responsible for managing manpower, optimizing resources, and coordinating with cross-functional teams for smooth production execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and execute daily, weekly, and monthly production schedules.
* Monitor fabrication activities and resolve production bottlenecks.
* Ensure compliance with quality standards, welding procedures, and fabrication processes.
* Lead and manage production teams, including supervisors, welders, and fitters.
* Enforce safety practices and regulatory compliance across operations.
* Coordinate with planning, design, stores, and logistics teams.
* Prepare production reports and provide progress updates to management.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, or Fabrication Engineering.
* 8-12 years of experience in fabrication, heavy engineering, or manufacturing.
* Strong knowledge of fabrication processes, welding standards, and production planning.
* Experience managing production teams and meeting project deadlines.
* Familiarity with ERP systems and production tracking tools.
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in fabrication yards or heavy engineering industries.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement practices.
* Exposure to quality management systems and client inspections.
* Strong analytical and resource optimization capabilities

Please contact us to request accommodation.

### **About the Role**

The Production Manager will oversee rubber manufacturing operations, ensuring efficient production, quality control, and adherence to safety and compliance standards. This role is responsible for managing production teams, optimizing processes, and meeting output targets in alignment with business goals.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* + Plan and execute daily, weekly, and monthly production schedules to meet output and delivery targets.
  + Ensure optimal utilization of manpower, machinery, materials, and rubber compounds.
  + Oversee rubber mixing, molding, curing, and finishing processes to maintain productivity and quality.
  + Monitor production KPIs, identify improvement opportunities, and drive waste and downtime reduction.
  + Ensure product quality standards through close coordination with QA/QC and laboratory testing teams.
  + Lead, train, and supervise production staff while fostering a culture of safety and continuous improvement.
  + Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and statutory requirements.
  + Coordinate with maintenance, stores, procurement, and planning teams for smooth plant operations.
  + Prepare production reports and provide regular performance updates to management.

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Rubber, Mechanical, Chemical, or Industrial Engineering; diploma holders with relevant experience may also apply.
* 8–12 years of experience in rubber manufacturing, with at least 3 years in a managerial role.
* Strong knowledge of rubber processing techniques and machinery.
* Experience in lean manufacturing, TPM, or Six Sigma preferred.
* Proficiency in production planning tools and ERP systems.

### **Key Skills**

* Production Planning & Control
* Rubber Processing Expertise
* Quality & Safety Management
* Team Leadership & Development
* Problem Solving & Decision Making
* Process Improvement & Cost Control
* Communication & Coordination
* ERP & Data Analysis

title: Project & Operations Manager – Web Development
description:
Project & Operations Manager

**Location:** Vadodara, Gujarat  
**Work Mode:** On-site  
**Experience:** 4–7 Years

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced **Project & Operations Manager** to manage client projects and day-to-day business operations. The ideal candidate should be strong in client communication, project coordination, team management, and problem-solving.

Key Responsibilities

**Project Management**

* Manage multiple website and software development projects from start to completion.
* Communicate with clients, understand requirements, collect tasks, and provide regular updates.
* Coordinate with developers, designers, SEO and other team members to ensure timely delivery.
* Create project timelines, assign tasks, track progress, and ensure deadlines are met.
* Identify project issues and ensure they are resolved quickly.
* Maintain strong client relationships and ensure client satisfaction.

**Technology Projects**

* Experience working with web development projects such as **Magento, Laravel, PHP, Shopify, WordPress, and SEO**.
* Should understand technical requirements well enough to communicate effectively with developers and clients.
* Technical coding expertise is not mandatory, but strong understanding of web development processes is required.

**Operations Management**

* Manage and improve day-to-day office and business operations.
* Ensure internal processes are followed and work is completed smoothly.
* Coordinate between different teams and make sure priorities are handled properly.
* Identify operational problems and implement solutions.
* Help management improve productivity, accountability, and overall workflow.
* Handle office-related coordination and administrative responsibilities when required.

**Sales & Business Support**

* Support the sales team with lead follow-ups, meetings, proposals, and client coordination.
* Attend sales/client meetings when required.
* Help management with new business opportunities and client requirements.
* Take ownership of tasks outside regular project management whenever business needs require.

Requirements

* 4–7 years of experience in **Project Management / Operations Management**, preferably in a web development or IT company.
* Excellent communication and client-handling skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Ability to manage developers and cross-functional teams.
* Good understanding of website development and digital technologies.
* Proactive, responsible, and solution-oriented attitude.
* Should be comfortable taking ownership beyond a traditional PM role.
* **Must be willing to work from our Vadodara office.**

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who can act as a **right-hand person for management**—someone who can manage projects, communicate with clients, coordinate the technical team, improve operations, support sales, and step in wherever required to keep the company running smoothly.

**Salary:** Competitive, based on experience and capabilities.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
